name: Copy Field
description: A read-only value with a copy button, for invite links, API keys and commands.

props.name: value
props.description: The text to show and copy.

props.name: masked
props.description: Shows dots and the last four characters, with a toggle to reveal the rest. Copying, with the button or the keyboard, always copies the real value.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the value, set off by a hairline, such as $ before a command.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the copy button has put the value on the clipboard.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the copy button.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and its buttons and dims them to 50%.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts the other props of the react-aria-components TextField, such as name and aria-label.
